question: 2026年6月30日库存余额最高的5个国库，列出国库简称和余额
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, balance from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' order by balance desc limit 5

question: 2026年6月30日余额超过50亿元的国库，列出简称和余额
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, balance from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' and balance>50

question: 国家金库常熟市支库2026年6月30日的库存余额，列出国库简称和余额
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, balance from treasury_balance_journal where treasury_short_name='国家金库常熟市支库' and stat_date='2026-06-30'

question: 把2026年6月30日各国库按余额从低到高列出简称和余额
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, balance from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' order by balance asc

question: 2026年6月30日哪个国库的库存最多，列出简称和余额
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, balance from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' order by balance desc limit 1

question: 各区县级国库2026年6月30日的库存余额，列出简称和余额，从高到低
referenceSql: select j.treasury_short_name, j.balance from treasury_balance_journal j join treasury_basic_info b on j.treasury_code=b.treasury_code where j.stat_date='2026-06-30' and b.treasury_level=4 order by j.balance desc

question: 2026年6月30日乡镇级国库的库存余额合计
referenceSql: select sum(j.balance) total from treasury_balance_journal j join treasury_basic_info b on j.treasury_code=b.treasury_code where j.stat_date='2026-06-30' and b.treasury_level=5

question: 列出国家金库苏州市中心支库直接下辖的国库简称和层级
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, treasury_level from treasury_basic_info where admin_treasury_name='国家金库苏州市中心支库'

question: 2026年6月每天全辖的库存余额合计，按日期先后排列
referenceSql: select stat_date, sum(balance) total from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date between '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30' group by stat_date order by stat_date asc

question: 2026年6月30日各所属县的库存余额合计（不含市库本级的占位行），从高到低
referenceSql: select county_treasury_name, sum(balance) total from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' and county_treasury_name <> 'NNNNNNNNNN' group by county_treasury_name order by total desc

question: 2026年6月全辖借方发生额合计
referenceSql: select sum(debit_amount) total from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date between '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30'

question: 2026年6月30日全辖库存余额合计
referenceSql: select sum(balance) total from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30'

question: 基础信息表中各层级的国库数量
referenceSql: select treasury_level, count(*) cnt from treasury_basic_info group by treasury_level

question: 2026年6月30日按所属县汇总余额超过50亿元的县及其余额合计
referenceSql: select county_treasury_name, sum(balance) total from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' group by county_treasury_name having sum(balance)>50

question: 2026年6月一般公共预算收入的本期金额合计（科目T010101）
referenceSql: select sum(current_period_amount) total from treasury_income_detail where stat_date='202606' and subject_code='T010101'

question: 2026年6月税收收入的年累计金额合计（科目101）
referenceSql: select sum(year_to_date_amount) total from treasury_income_detail where stat_date='202606' and subject_code='101'

question: 2026年6月全口径国库收入的本期金额（四本预算汇总科目合计）
referenceSql: select sum(current_period_amount) total from treasury_income_detail where stat_date='202606' and subject_code in ('T010101','T010201','T010401','T010601')

question: 昆山市2026年6月的一般公共预算收入本期金额
referenceSql: select sum(current_period_amount) total from treasury_income_detail where stat_date='202606' and subject_code='T010101' and treasury_short_name='昆山市'

question: 2026年6月各国库的税收收入本期金额，从高到低取前5
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, sum(current_period_amount) total from treasury_income_detail where stat_date='202606' and subject_code='101' group by treasury_short_name order by total desc limit 5

question: 2026年上半年逐月的税收收入本期金额合计，按月份排序
referenceSql: select stat_date, sum(current_period_amount) total from treasury_income_detail where stat_date between '202601' and '202606' and subject_code='101' group by stat_date order by stat_date asc

question: 2026年6月30日各国库余额的平均值
referenceSql: select avg(balance) avg_bal from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30'

question: 2026年6月单库单日借方发生额的最大值
referenceSql: select max(debit_amount) mx from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date between '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30'

question: 库存日记账中出现过哪些所属县名称？去重列出
referenceSql: select distinct county_treasury_name from treasury_balance_journal

question: 2026年6月有收入入库记录的国库有几个
referenceSql: select count(distinct treasury_code) cnt from treasury_income_detail where stat_date='202606'

question: 按2026年6月30日余额分档统计国库数：50亿元及以上为高，10亿元及以上为中，其余为低
referenceSql: select case when balance >= 50 then '高' when balance >= 10 then '中' else '低' end as tier, count(*) as cnt from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' group by tier

question: 给每个国库打2026年6月30日的余额档位标签：50亿元及以上为大库，其余为普通，列出国库简称和档位
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, case when balance >= 50 then '大库' else '普通' end as tier from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30'

question: 2026年6月30日余额高于全辖平均余额的国库，列出简称和余额
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, balance from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' and balance > (select avg(balance) from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30')

question: 2026年6月30日余额比国家金库常熟市支库还高的国库，列出简称和余额
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, balance from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30' and balance > (select balance from treasury_balance_journal where treasury_short_name='国家金库常熟市支库' and stat_date='2026-06-30')

question: 2026年6月有收入入库记录的国库简称（按基础信息表列出）
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name from treasury_basic_info where treasury_code in (select treasury_code from treasury_income_detail where stat_date='202606')

question: 每个所属县中2026年6月30日余额排名前2的国库，列出所属县、国库简称、余额及组内排名，按所属县升序、余额降序排列
referenceSql: select county_treasury_name, treasury_short_name, balance, rn from (select county_treasury_name, treasury_short_name, balance, row_number() over (partition by county_treasury_name order by balance desc) as rn from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date='2026-06-30') t where rn <= 2 order by county_treasury_name asc, balance desc

question: 国家金库昆山市支库2026年6月的逐日余额及前一日余额，按日期先后排列
referenceSql: select stat_date, balance, lag(balance, 1) over (order by stat_date) as prev_bal from treasury_balance_journal where treasury_short_name='国家金库昆山市支库' and stat_date between '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30' order by stat_date

question: 2026年6月全辖逐日贷方发生额及按日累计，按日期先后排列
referenceSql: select stat_date, total, sum(total) over (order by stat_date) as running_total from (select stat_date, sum(credit_amount) as total from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date between '2026-06-01' and '2026-06-30' group by stat_date) g order by stat_date

question: 基础信息表和库存日记账各有多少条记录？合并成两行输出，只要数量这一列
referenceSql: select count(*) as cnt from treasury_basic_info union all select count(*) as cnt from treasury_balance_journal

question: 把基础信息表的国库简称和日记账里出现过的所属县名称合并成一份去重名单，按名称排序
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name as name from treasury_basic_info union select county_treasury_name from treasury_balance_journal order by name

question: 基础信息表里2026年6月30日没有库存记录的国库，列出简称
referenceSql: select b.treasury_short_name from treasury_basic_info b left join treasury_balance_journal j on b.treasury_code = j.treasury_code and j.stat_date='2026-06-30' where j.id is null

question: 不是区县级、也不是乡镇级的国库，列出简称和层级
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name, treasury_level from treasury_basic_info where treasury_level not in (4, 5)

question: 找出借方发生额为空的库存记录，列出日期和国库简称
referenceSql: select stat_date, treasury_short_name from treasury_balance_journal where debit_amount is null

question: 按月份统计2026年的借方发生额合计，列出月份和金额，按月份排序
referenceSql: select date_format(stat_date, '%Y-%m') as ym, sum(debit_amount) as total from treasury_balance_journal where stat_date >= '2026-01-01' and stat_date <= '2026-12-31' group by ym order by ym

question: 按年份统计库存日记账的记录条数
referenceSql: select date_format(stat_date, '%Y') as y, count(*) as cnt from treasury_balance_journal group by y

question: 简称以「国家金库苏州市」开头的国库，列出简称
referenceSql: select treasury_short_name from treasury_basic_info where treasury_short_name like '国家金库苏州市%'
